title: Letters and Orchard
author: Bram Eriksen
blurb: Jude Reyes, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
